## Data Flow Summary

### Complete Pipeline

```
1. Simulation (generates raw results)
   ├─ main.py (BGN model)
   ├─ main.py with KP model
   └─ main.py with GS model
   └─> Outputs to: new_results/*.csv

2. Data Processing
   └─ data_processing.py
      └─> Loads: new_results/results_{method}_{theory}.csv
      └─> Outputs: Python dataframes (dkkm, fama, ipca)

3. Figure Generation
   └─ BGN/Code/analysis.ipynb
      └─> Creates: Images (main)/for tex/*.pdf
      ├─ dkkm_bgn_ver3.pdf
      ├─ dkkm_kp_ver3.pdf
      ├─ dkkm_gs_ver3.pdf
      ├─ ipca_bgn_ver3.pdf
      ├─ ipca_kp_ver3.pdf
      └─ ipca_gs_ver3.pdf

4. Table Generation
   └─ Unknown script (likely in analysis.ipynb)
      └─> Creates: Tables (main)/for tex/*.tex
      ├─ fama_comparisons.tex
      ├─ dkkm_comparisons.tex
      ├─ kps_comparisons.tex
      └─ sdf_weight_statistics_2.tex

5. LaTeX Compilation
   └─ Tex/main.tex
      └─> Includes all figures and tables
      └─> Outputs: final PDF paper
```

## Source Data Files (in new_results/)

Based on `data_processing.py`, the required CSV files are:

### Time Series Data
- `results_tseries_bgn.csv` (columns: iter, month, sdf_ret)
- `results_tseries_kp.csv`
- `results_tseries_gs.csv`

### Method Results (for each theory: bgn, kp, gs)
- `results_dkkm_{theory}.csv`
  - Columns: iter, month, include_mkt, alpha, nfeatures, method, xret, mn, stdev

- `results_fama_{theory}.csv`
  - Columns: iter, month, method (ff/fm), xret, mn, stdev

- `results_ipca_{theory}.csv`
  - Columns: iter, month, ipca factors, xret, mn, stdev

- `results_model_{theory}.csv`
  - Columns: iter, month, sdf_ret
